Anthropic, the company behind Claude, raised $81.3 billion in the biggest IPO ever and ended its first day valued at about $1.76 trillion. Uday Kotak asked if Indian companies are undervalued. Adani Group CFO Jugeshinder Singh called it a "textbook category error". Vrinda Tulsian explains the IPO, the numbers behind it, and the debate it set off in India.
